2.title: Step 2 — The personal sacrifice

aaron.caption: Aaron offers the bull for himself and his household before entering the Most Holy Place as High Priest.
aaron.scripture_excerpt: Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

jesus.caption: Jesus dies as the corresponding sacrifice for Himself on Calvary.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.

2.comparison: Aaron’s personal bull represents the sacrifice required before his ministry; Jesus gives Himself as the once-for-all sacrifice for sin.
2.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Step 2

3.title: Step 3 — Washing before the Most Holy Place

aaron.caption: Aaron washes his hands and feet at the laver before entering the Most Holy Place as a common priest.
aaron.scripture_excerpt: Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat, when they go into the tabernacle of the congregation.

jesus.caption: Jesus’ resurrection marks His passage from death into the heavenly ministry, with the former condition removed from Him.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

3.comparison: Aaron washes before the next phase of service. Jesus rises victorious over death and begins the corresponding heavenly phase of ministry.
3.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Step 3

4.title: Step 4 — Incense and entrance before God

aaron.caption: Aaron takes the censer and incense through the veil into the Most Holy Place, where the incense covers the mercy seat.
aaron.scripture_excerpt: He shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail.

jesus.caption: Jesus passes through the heavenly Holy Place as the common priest on His way to the Father.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father.

4.comparison: Aaron’s incense accompanies entrance before God. Jesus ascends to the Father and ministers through the greater and more perfect tabernacle.
4.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Step 4

5.title: Step 5 — Acceptance by the blood

aaron.caption: Aaron stands in the common priest’s robe of righteousness, with incense representing Christ’s merits and the bull’s blood representing sacrifice, while the glory of God accepts the service.
aaron.scripture_excerpt: He shall sprinkle of the blood with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward seven times.

jesus.caption: Jesus stands as High Priest in the heavenly sanctuary, presenting His own blood and remaining accepted by the Father.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: By his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.

5.comparison: Aaron’s acceptance rests on the blood and merits represented in the earthly service. Jesus presents the reality of His own sacrifice in the heavenly sanctuary.
5.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Step 5

6.title: Step 6 — Return to the court and co-laborers

aaron.caption: Aaron returns to the court, meets with his fellow priests, and returns to the altar to complete the morning service with the lamb.
aaron.scripture_excerpt: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it.

jesus.caption: Jesus returns to earth and meets with His disciples and co-laborers for forty days after His resurrection.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: He shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days.

6.comparison: Aaron returns to the court after acceptance and continues the service with his fellow priests. Jesus spends forty days with His disciples before ascending.
6.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Step 6

7.title: Step 7 — Renewed washing and restored stature

aaron.caption: Aaron stops at the laver a second time to wash his hands and feet before entering the Holy Place as High Priest.
aaron.scripture_excerpt: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal.

jesus.caption: Jesus changes from the stature of a common priest to the stature of the High Priest as He enters the heavenly sanctuary.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: Before Christ’s resurrection He was seen in human likeness; after His resurrection He enters the heavenly ministry in glorified stature.

7.comparison: Aaron washes again before the High Priest phase. Jesus enters the heavenly ministry in His resurrected and glorified condition.
7.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Step 7

8.title: Step 8 — High-priestly investiture

aaron.caption: Aaron dresses in the High Priest’s garments and enters the Holy Place to begin the High Priest’s work.
aaron.scripture_excerpt: He shall put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people.

jesus.caption: Jesus enters through the first veil as High Priest after ascending and being inaugurated for His heavenly ministry.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens.

8.comparison: Aaron’s change of garments marks the High Priest’s ministry. Jesus is inaugurated as the true High Priest and minister of the heavenly sanctuary.
8.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Step 8

9.title: Step 9 — Light and Pentecost

aaron.caption: Aaron pours oil into the lamp so the light burns continually in the Holy Place.
aaron.scripture_excerpt: They shall bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

jesus.caption: Jesus pours out the Holy Spirit at Pentecost after entering the heavenly sanctuary as High Priest.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: Ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me.

9.comparison: Aaron supplies oil for continual light. Jesus sends the Holy Spirit, empowering the disciples to bear witness throughout the world.
9.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Step 9

10.title: Step 10 — The Daily Service ends

aaron.caption: Aaron places incense on the altar as the High Priest, while the daily service continues through the morning sacrifice, transferred sin, and evening service.
aaron.sanctuary_location: Holy Place — altar of incense and Court — altar
aaron.scripture_excerpt: Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

jesus.caption: Jesus is reinstated as ruler of the universe and High Priest after His ascension; the Daily Service closes with the forty days and the ascent to heaven completed.
jesus.scripture_excerpt: He ever liveth to make intercession for them.

10.comparison: The daily service closes after the morning and evening ministry. Aaron’s incense and sacrifices correspond to Christ’s continuing intercession and the completion of His ascension ministry.
10.source_citation: The Sanctuary Cross — Daily Service, Steps 10A–10B
